name: Kitty
source:
She doesn't seem frantic or anxious, or scared. She's just... there, responsive, but passive at the same time. The pink hair is definitely a unique trait, like the blindfold.

Sat on her little blanket, she has all the energy of a sleeping puppy, and about the same degree of personality. Pretty to look at, but not very engaging at all.
